content.title: About
content.content: Green olives are the unripe fruits of the olive tree (Olea europaea) harvested before they fully mature. They have a slightly bitter taste, firm flesh, and are usually fermented or brined to reduce bitterness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green olives are typically picked in late summer while still immature.
Traditional processing includes fermentation in brine, oil, or alkaline solutions to remove bitter polyphenols.
The olive tree has been a symbol of peace and victory in ancient Greece and Rome.
Olive oil derived from olives is considered one of the healthiest plant fats.
There are over 500 olive varieties, each giving a distinct flavor profile.

items.title: Rich in monounsaturated fats
items.content: Olives contain oleic acid, which supports cardiovascular health.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Polyphenols such as oleuropein protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The fiber in olives aids regular bowel function.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Olives provide vitamin E, iron, copper, and small amounts of calcium.

items.title: Anti‑inflammatory properties
items.content: Polyphenolic compounds may help reduce inflammation in the body.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Brined olives often contain a lot of salt, which can be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Olive allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to olives or olive oil.

items.title: Olive oil sensitivity
items.content: Large amounts of olives may cause gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive people.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Green olives are commonly served as a snack, added to salads, pasta, pizza, and tapas. They can be used in marinades, sauces, and spreads, or blended into a paste (pesto).

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep olives in their original brine in a sealed jar in the refrigerator. Properly stored, they last several months. Discard any that develop mold or an off‑odor.
